name: Validate-Calibrated SNPE
purpose: Test the smallest feasible robust-SBI extension already supported by the current runner
concrete_work: Run 4 Falcon V100 seed replications of the strongest 12288-train SNPE MAF config with validation-selected mean-vs-median decision rule and compare against the current SNPE baseline.
promotion_rule: Promote only if the selected-rule path clears the material-improvement threshold and the gain survives the 4-seed block.
omit_if_settled: If the 4-seed block is flat or inconsistent do not expand this branch into a larger decision-rule sweep

name: Feature-Aware SNPE
purpose: Test whether informative summary-style observation encodings materially improve SNPE on this HH task

promotion_rule: Promote only if summary-aware SNPE improves the clean frontier or reduces drift/mask instability by the material-improvement threshold.
omit_if_settled: If raw-trace SNPE still dominates after the first serious feature-aware block do not widen this branch further
